title: Owned the program that raised the average craftsmanship score from 67 to 78
summary: I was accountable for the software craftsmanship assessment program. I directed global teams to set policies, reviewed their KPIs and goals, and oversaw the rollout that lifted the average assessment score from 67 to 78.
what_would_have_happened: Engineering practice would stay unmeasured, and improvement would stay anecdotal.
the_call: Measure engineering practice with one common assessment and hold teams to KPIs against it.
what_i_did: Reviewed each team's KPIs and goals against the assessment and oversaw implementation and coaching on the gaps it exposed.
what_changed: The average assessment score rose from 67 to 78.
